## Analysis overview

Selects non-LOCF post-baseline ADAS-Cog total records for efficacy subjects and runs the repeated-measures efficacy model through Week 24.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADQSADAS`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAMCD`: ACTOT parameter
- `CHG`: change from baseline
- `AVISITN`: analysis visit number
- `DTYPE`: derivation type
- `EFFFL/ANL01FL`: selection flags
- `TRTP/TRTPN`: planned treatment.
